purpose: Developer handoff: official CLI observations and direct-protocol feasibility verification, not production plugin acceptance

batches.note: All requests in this batch were emitted by the official CLI. Original limitations describe this batch only; subsequent checks appear in verification.json.
One official CLI baseline plus eleven named direct-protocol probes. The two 429 requests are deliberate original-Pi-prompt controls. The image request is not an official CLI image-tool capture.

redaction.arbitraryStrings: Many values replaced with objects containing redacted=true, length and a truncated SHA-256 digest; selected identifiers also have a shape
redaction.intendedUse: Structural comparison and construction of separate synthetic regression inputs
redaction.digestCaution: Not all digests are full SHA-256. A digest is not a usable original identifier, thought signature, credential, or wire value.

verificationLimits: Success establishes the tested application-layer protocol, not TLS/client-fingerprint equivalence or support for every account/model/version
Full provider registration, UI integration, concurrent/resumed sessions, cancellation and malformed-stream handling still require implementation and tests
